The issue was that `append_tokens` in `rich/text.py` updated the `Text` object's internal length (`self._length`) only after successfully iterating through all tokens. If the `tokens` iterable (e.g., a generator) raised an exception during iteration, the `Text` object's content (`self._text`) would be partially updated, but its length would remain unchanged, leading to an inconsistent state where `len(text)` did not match the actual length of the text.
